Meet The Team

Alex, John and the Team

Smart Call Contractors is run by Alex and John from Grimsby, with a team of 5. We do roofing, from repairs and chimneys to flat roofs and full re-roofs, and we lay resin, block paving and tarmac driveways, patios and paths, so one local team can look after the whole outside of your home.

Alex is trained by TuffStuff on their Flexiplus and Flexible GRP flat roof waterproofing systems. John's name comes up in 18 of our Checkatrade reviews, many of them for how quickly he got back to people and came out to look at the job.

Alex and JohnOwners, Smart Call Contractors

What Makes Us Different

  1. 01

    Roofs and Driveways, One Team

    New roofs, flat roofs, repairs and chimneys, and resin, block paving and tarmac driveways, patios and garden landscaping. One local team for the roof over your head and the ground outside your door.

  2. 02

    Roofing Contractors of the Year

  3. 03

    Registered Resin Installers

    Most Jobs Done in One to Three Days

    Most of our jobs take one to three days.
